comments.value: This feature is long overdue, let's get this added!

It would also be nice to be able to force the eyes to look away too, even though it would be less commonly used it would be good for some pictures where you want to look like you're looking at something else.

gonna bump this, people have been asking for it for years. it can't possibly be that hard to locally redirect the lookat component to lookat the camera, when a button on the camera is pressed for it. (or a menu button)
I would also like an option to just disable the fake gaze/looking effect too, but this is a good idea as well.
I would love to see this for sure... maybe we could have more control over it by pointing in a direction with a controller and either locking it there or just having it follow the controller pointer.
Need this for video recording and pictures!! It would do so much for content creators

details: See the attached photos for comparisons. The eyes following the lens allows for a more realistic camera experience. Having it as a toggle in the camera settings will help when taking candid photos of people, so they ignore the camera. But toggling it on will allow everyone to look at the camera, just like a real photo.
title: Toggle In Camera For Avatars Eyes To Follow Camera Lens
